File:    src/xdemos/glxgears.c (extracted standalone; rest of mesa-demos discarded)

License: MIT (see COPYING in this directory).

Refresh by running `bash scripts/fetch-third-party.sh` from repo root;
version is pinned in scripts/fetch-third-party.sh's LIBS table.

Patches under scripts/third-party/glxgears/patches/ are applied in
sorted order; their job is the minimum needed to run under em-x11
without modifying the test logic itself.
